business_problem: Zenken needed to reduce manual research, proposal drafting, translation, and meeting preparation work that constrained sales productivity and slowed international expansion across a lean organization.
solution_summary: Zenken rolled out ChatGPT Enterprise as an AI-first operating layer across sales, web marketing, and its overseas human-resources business. After evaluating solutions against twelve requirements around security and advanced reasoning, the company standardized on ChatGPT Enterprise and layered in GPT-5, reasoning models, custom GPTs, and image-generation tools to support both strategic analysis and day-to-day execution. In sales, teams use ChatGPT for prospect research, meeting preparation, live question handling, proposal drafting, and personalized follow-up, shifting conversations from checklist discovery to consultative selling. In the HR business, the same platform translates contracts, job postings, and multilingual communication with better context retention than earlier tools. Employees also use it for marketing content, internal documents, and strategic hypothesis generation, allowing work once outsourced to move in-house while managers and staff refine AI-assisted outputs together.

solution_components.role: Acts as Zenken’s secure organization-wide AI workspace for sales, marketing, translation, and internal knowledge work.

solution_components.name: GPT-5
solution_components.role: Supports higher-value analysis and content tasks across Zenken’s core businesses.

solution_components.name: Custom GPTs
solution_components.role: Tailor AI support to repeatable internal tasks and business-specific workflows.

solution_components.name: Reasoning model
solution_components.role: Provides deeper support for management-level analysis, market strategy, and new-business evaluation.

data_flow: Prospect information, proposal requirements, multilingual documents, and internal planning tasks are fed into ChatGPT Enterprise and supporting models. Outputs become research briefs, translated content, sales emails, proposals, and strategic hypotheses that employees refine during meetings and client work.
business_outcome: Zenken improved sales win rates and proposal quality, saved large amounts of knowledge-work time, reduced outsourcing spend, and enabled a smaller team to sustain international growth with far more AI-assisted throughput.
